import re
# Criteria from task
print('Task instruction: Mark "Witnessing a total solar eclipse" in my Bucket List Simple Note as done.')

note_id = 251
# Load current note content
cur = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=access_token)
content = cur['content']
line_old = '[ ] Witnessing a total solar eclipse'
line_new = '[x] Witnessing a total solar eclipse'

# Locate line occurrences
old_occ = [ln for ln in content.splitlines() if ln.strip() == line_old]
new_occ = [ln for ln in content.splitlines() if ln.strip() == line_new]

# Compose updated content
updated_content = content.replace(line_old, line_new)
# Verify at least one replacement occurred
print('Note:', cur['note_id'], cur['title'])
print('Occurrences of old line:', len(old_occ))
print('Occurrences of new line:', len(new_occ))
print('After replace: old line exists?', line_old in updated_content)
print('After replace: new line exists?', line_new in updated_content)

# Build verification table data (single row)
rows = [
    {
        'Item': 'Witnessing a total solar eclipse',
        'Before': ('done' if line_new in content else 'not done'),
        'After': ('done' if line_new in updated_content else 'not done'),
        'Replaced?': old_occ != []
    }
]
print('Verification table:', rows)
